summary: X-16 is a Supabase Auth-only screen. It collects a new password from a user who arrived via a recovery link and calls supabase.auth.updateUser({ password }). All three source docs (description.md, functional-spec.md, screen-data-summary.md) and the implementation (PasswordResetConfirmForm.tsx) agree: the password is stored in the Supabase Auth internal store (auth.users), NOT in any public-schema table in the LIVE schema. There is no app DB read or write on this screen. Every screen data requirement is either an Auth-internal action, a client-only transient (confirm match, strength meter, computed expiry), or static UI copy — none map to a LIVE public-schema column. The one 스키마 보강 필요 item (password-policy copy) is escalated to UNRESOLVED per the FROZEN/escalate rule (no description.md stable-query need; do not invent a column).

rows.screenRequirement: 새 비밀번호 저장 (store the new password)
rows.docSource: description.md §6 '완료 CTA + 실패 알림' L90 (supabase.auth.updateUser({ password })); screen-data-summary.md '운영/관리 대상 데이터 계약' L32 (확정 계약: 비밀번호 변경은 Supabase Auth updateUser 흐름이며 public schema 테이블에 저장하지 않는다); functional-spec.md '데이터 사용' L50 (Supabase Auth:updateUser / password)
rows.rationale: Password persistence is handled entirely by Supabase Auth (auth.users internal store), which is intentionally OUT of the public-schema LIVE baseline. All three docs explicitly state there is no public-schema table for this. The implementation confirms the only persistence is supabase.auth.updateUser({ password }). This is satisfied by-design via Auth, not a public-schema gap — no column to add.

rows.screenRequirement: 비밀번호 확인 일치 검증 (password confirm match)
rows.docSource: description.md §3 '비밀번호 입력' L56-58 (확인값 일치 검사, 불일치는 필드 하단 즉시 표시); functional-spec.md '주요 기능' L27 (비밀번호 확인 일치 검증)
rows.rationale: Confirm-match is a client-only Form validator (PasswordResetConfirmForm.tsx L152-159). It is never persisted; the confirm value is a transient input compared in-browser. No DB object expected or needed.

rows.docSource: description.md §3 L56 (새 비밀번호 8-64자 필수, 가입 A-01·재설정 X-06과 동일 정책); functional-spec.md '주요 기능' L28
rows.rationale: Length is enforced by client Form rules (min:8/max:64, PasswordResetConfirmForm.tsx L131-135) and Supabase Auth settings. No persisted operational length policy is needed for this screen; it is a static validation constant aligned with A-01/X-06.

rows.screenRequirement: 비밀번호 강도/규칙 실시간 체크리스트 (4단계 강도 바 + 길이/대소문자/숫자/특수문자)
rows.docSource: description.md §3 L56 (규칙 실시간 검증 + 4단계 강도 바); functional-spec.md '주요 기능' L29; '미구현/불일치' L73 (강도/규칙 체크리스트는 권장 안내, 차단 아님)
rows.rationale: Strength scoring is purely client-side (PasswordStrengthMeter + password-strength.ts; PasswordResetConfirmForm.tsx L144). It is advisory (non-blocking) and never stored. No DB object involved.

rows.screenRequirement: 링크 만료 시간 안내 (절대/상대 병기, '약 60분 후(HH:mm쯤)')
rows.docSource: description.md §4 '안내 카피' L66-70 (만료 시간 절대/상대 병기, '약'으로 명시, SSR에서 계산 안 함); functional-spec.md '주요 기능' L30 + '미구현/불일치' L72 (만료 시각은 진입 시각 + 약 60분 추정값)
rows.rationale: Expiry is computed client-side as entry-time + ~60 min (LINK_TTL_MINUTES=60, lazy init on mount; PasswordResetConfirmForm.tsx L46-50). Docs explicitly say the exact issuance time is NOT available to the client (arrives from email) hence the '약' hedge — there is intentionally no DB source for it. No column expected.

rows.docSource: description.md §1 L30 (Supabase recovery session이 있는 브라우저에서 저장), 예외 L34 (없거나 만료 시 실패 알림); functional-spec.md '사용자와 권한' L12 (저장 action은 recovery session 필요); screen-data-summary.md 'RLS/권한 기준' L43 (세션 검증은 Supabase Auth가 처리한다)
rows.rationale: Recovery session validation is handled by Supabase Auth (token exchange at /auth/callback?type=recovery; session check at updateUser). screen-data-summary.md states session verification is Supabase Auth's responsibility. No public-schema profiles/session object is read by this screen — profiles.app_role / RLS are not consulted here. Auth-internal, satisfied by-design.

rows.screenRequirement: 비밀번호 조건/정책 문구 운영화 (password policy copy as operational data)
rows.docSource: screen-data-summary.md '운영/관리 대상 데이터 계약' L33 (label='스키마 보강 필요'; 확정 계약: 비밀번호 정책 문구를 운영 데이터로 관리하는 구조는 없다; 메모: Auth 설정과 앱 validation 문구를 맞춰야 한다) + '스키마 정합성 메모' L46 + '검수 필요 항목' L49; functional-spec.md '추가 발견 후보' L78
rows.rationale: CONTRACT-NOT-LABEL applied: the row is LABELED '스키마 보강 필요' but the 확정 계약 + 메모 say there is NO operational structure today and the copy should be reconciled between Auth settings and app validation strings (currently static i18n in the client). description.md states NO concrete query/validation/render need for a DB-backed policy table (strength rules are advisory client-side per §3/L73). Per STABLE-QUERY rule there is no stable-query need, so no column is invented. This is a genuinely net-new operational-config surface (policy-copy management) with no existing LIVE object — routed to UNRESOLVED to escalate, never applied. Not jsonb-covered because no existing jsonb blob serves it.

rows.screenRequirement: 저장 완료 메시지 + 로그인 이동 (success copy + redirect to /login)
rows.docSource: description.md §6 L90-91 ('비밀번호가 변경되었습니다. 다시 로그인하세요.' → A-02 /login); 분기 L105 (성공: /login); screen-data-summary.md '저장/조회/이벤트 흐름' L39
rows.rationale: Success message is a static i18n string (t('changeSuccess')) and the redirect is a client router.push('/login') (PasswordResetConfirmForm.tsx L71-72). No persistence, no DB read. study_events is NOT used here (auth flow, not a study event in the frozen event_type catalog).

rows.screenRequirement: 실패 알림 + 재발송 링크 (warning alert + /password-reset resend)
rows.docSource: description.md §6 예외 L94 (저장 실패/링크 만료/세션 끊김을 동일 warning 알림으로 묶고 재시도 + /password-reset 재발송); functional-spec.md '상태/오류' L39-40 (mapSupabaseErrorCode canonical message, data-testid='password-reset-confirm-error')
rows.rationale: Failure handling maps the raw Supabase Auth error code via mapSupabaseErrorCode → canonical i18n message (no DB lookup); the resend link is a static <Link href='/password-reset'>. raw provider errors/tokens are intentionally NOT surfaced (description L92/L114). All client/static; no DB object.

jsonMappingNote: No seed JSON exists for X-16 (Auth-only screen, no app DB rows to seed). Per the task, step 2 is a no-op. JSON MAPPING RULE / provenance preservation does not apply because there is no source JSON file or JSON item id to preserve.
frozenIslandNote: No FROZEN-island objects (organizations, org_members, assignments, assignment_submissions, admin_*/get_admin_*) and no admin codes (H-01/X-08/X-10/X-15) are touched by this screen. The one schema-augmentation candidate (password-policy copy) is genuinely net-new operational config with no existing LIVE object and is routed to UNRESOLVED (escalate, never apply) rather than added.
migrationNote: No migration emitted. This screen produces zero additive/idempotent migrations because it has no public-schema DB contract: password persistence is Supabase Auth-internal (auth.users), and the only unresolved item (policy-copy operationalization) is escalated, not applied. No db reset/drop/truncate (would be destructive and is never performed). A re-run with unchanged sources is a byte-identical no-op (nothing to seed/upsert).
